title: Space Explorer Mission
description: An astronaut discovers alien life on a distant planet

scenes.text: A brave astronaut in a white spacesuit lands on a colorful alien planet with purple mountains.
She meets friendly blue alien creatures with big eyes in a field of glowing flowers.
The astronaut and aliens work together to build a beautiful crystal city.
